Hypersensitivity and skin reactions have been associated with ciprofloxacin and other fluoroquinolones. Reports have included anaphylaxis (which has sometimes been fatal, and may occur after the first dose),1-7 serum sickness,8 Ste- vens-Johnson syndrome,9 toxic epidermal necrolysis (some- times fatal),10-17 laryngeal oedema,18 and vasculitis.19-21 Fatal vasculitis has been reported with ofloxacin.22 1.
